options.text: islets of Langerhans in the pancreas

questions.explanation: The islets of Langerhans in the pancreas secrete insulin, which lowers blood glucose, and glucagon, which raises it. The thyroid makes thyroxine, the pituitary makes ADH and growth hormone, and the adrenal makes adrenaline.

distractorRationale.b: The pituitary secretes ADH, growth hormone and tropic hormones

questions.stem: Compared with a nerve impulse, a hormone typically

options.text: acts faster and on a more precise target
acts more slowly and often on a wider range of tissues
is an electrical message that travels along an axon
cannot reach organs far from where it is made

questions.explanation: Hormones are chemicals carried in the blood, so they take seconds to minutes to arrive and can affect every tissue that has the matching receptor. Nerve impulses are electrical, reach a single effector in milliseconds, and stop almost at once.

distractorRationale.a: That description fits nervous, not hormonal, coordination
distractorRationale.c: Electrical axonal messages are nerve impulses
distractorRationale.d: Blood carries hormones to distant organs; that is their advantage

questions.stem: A swollen thyroid gland in a person whose diet lacks seafood or iodised salt is most likely due to deficiency of

options.text: iodine, leading to low thyroxine and a goitre

questions.explanation: Thyroxine contains iodine. When iodine is scarce the pituitary keeps stimulating the thyroid with TSH, the gland enlarges, and a goitre results. Insulin deficiency causes diabetes mellitus, not a neck swelling.

distractorRationale.a: Insulin deficiency causes diabetes mellitus, not goitre
distractorRationale.d: Adrenaline is not linked to iodine or to a swollen thyroid

questions.stem: A shoot bends towards light because auxin

options.text: is destroyed on the shaded side, so that side grows more slowly
accumulates on the shaded side, where it promotes cell elongation
causes the shoot tip to contract like a muscle
ripens the tissues on the lit side

questions.explanation: Unilateral light redistributes auxin towards the shaded side. Auxin makes those cells elongate faster, so the shaded side outgrows the lit side and the shoot curves towards the light. Ethene, not auxin, is the ripening hormone.

distractorRationale.a: Auxin is not destroyed on the shade; it accumulates there
distractorRationale.c: Plant cells elongate; they do not contract like animal muscle
distractorRationale.d: Ripening is the role of ethene, and it is not how phototropism works

questions.stem: Which hormone is correctly matched with its gland and one of its effects?
questions.explanation: Thyroxine from the thyroid raises the rate of chemical reactions in cells. ADH is from the pituitary and acts on the kidney; insulin is from the pancreas and acts on blood glucose; adrenaline is from the adrenal, not the ovary.

distractorRationale.a: ADH is from the pituitary and controls water reabsorption, not glucose
distractorRationale.c: Insulin is from the pancreas; water reabsorption is ADH
distractorRationale.d: Adrenaline is from the adrenal glands; the ovary secretes oestrogen and progesterone

questions.stem: Green plantains in a closed bowl ripen faster when one ripe fruit is added because the ripe fruit releases
questions.explanation: Ethene is a gaseous plant hormone that triggers ripening. A ripe fruit gives it off, so neighbouring fruits in a closed space ripen together. Auxin controls tropisms and apical dominance; insulin and adrenaline are animal hormones.

distractorRationale.a: Auxin elongates cells in tropisms; it is not the main ripening gas
distractorRationale.b: Insulin is an animal hormone from the pancreas
distractorRationale.d: Adrenaline is an animal emergency hormone

questions.stem: A patient produces large volumes of urine that contains glucose. The deficient hormone and its gland are
questions.explanation: Glucose in the urine plus high urine volume is diabetes mellitus: without insulin, blood glucose stays high, exceeds the kidney's reabsorption threshold and is lost in the urine, taking water with it. Diabetes insipidus (ADH lack) also gives large urine volumes, but that urine does not contain glucose.

distractorRationale.a: ADH deficiency is diabetes insipidus; the urine is dilute but sugar-free
distractorRationale.c: Thyroxine deficiency lowers metabolic rate and may cause goitre, not sugary urine
distractorRationale.d: Adrenaline briefly raises blood glucose in an emergency; it is not the cause of this chronic pattern

questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares the withdrawal of a hand from a hot pot with the rise in blood glucose caused by adrenaline?

options.text: Both are electrical messages that last for hours
The withdrawal is a rapid, localised nervous reflex; the glucose rise is a slower, widespread hormonal effect
Adrenaline travels along a sensory neurone to the hand
Both require the hormone to cross a synapse in the spinal cord

questions.explanation: The hot-pot response is a spinal reflex: fast, electrical, and aimed at one set of muscles. Adrenaline is secreted into blood and reaches heart, liver, lungs and many other organs, so its effects are slower to start and more general. The two systems often work together in an emergency, but they remain distinct kinds of message.

distractorRationale.a: Nervous messages are brief, not hours long; hormones are chemical, not electrical
distractorRationale.c: Adrenaline is carried in blood, not along a sensory neurone
distractorRationale.d: Only the nervous pathway uses spinal synapses; adrenaline does not
